observations: Front panel features a power button and three LED indicators (red, yellow, green).
Green 'V' logo on the bottom front of the unit.
Image contains watermarks 'STABLE POWER' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

risks.proof: Photo of the manufacturer's label on the back or bottom of the unit.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest standard capacity (e.g., 600VA)

risks.proof: Video of the UPS powering a significant load (like a desktop PC or lamp) while unplugged from the wall.
risks.if_unproven: as having a dead battery requiring replacement

risks.proof: Video showing the unit successfully completing a self-test and switching between AC and battery modes.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification label on the back or bottom of the unit showing the model and VA rating.
Video of the unit powered on, showing it holding a load when the mains power is disconnected.
response.reason: The capacity (VA rating) is the most important factor for pricing a UPS and it is not visible in the photo or specified in the text. A photo of the rear label is required.
